name: Shoppers Stop Ltd
about: Company Overview Shoppers Stop Ltd. is the nation's leading premier retailer of fashion and beauty brands established in 1991. [1] It has 800+ Brands under its portfolio and 271 Stores spread across 50 cities in India as of 31st Dec 2022. [2]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Shoppers Stop Ltd., established in 1991, is India’s premier fashion and beauty retailer. Offering 800+ brands and an omnichannel presence, the company is dedicated to delivering premium retail experiences.
cons: Stock is trading at 14.6 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.27% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 16 Nov

Intimation For Change In Correspondence Address Of The Registrar To An Issue And Share Transfer Agent Of The Company 4 Nov - KFin Technologies’ corporate office address changes effective December 1, 2026.

Update Regarding Investment In Global SS Beauty Brands Limited (GSSBBL), Wholly Owned Material Subsidiary Of The Company -Intimation Under Regulation 30(6) Of The Securities And Exchange Board Of India (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') Reference: Subscription To Issue Of 1000 0.01% Non-Cumulative Optionally Convertible Preference Shares ('NOCPS') Of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) Of GSSBBL On Right Basis. 26 Oct - Shoppers Stop invested Rs 10 crore in GSSBBL preference shares on October 26, 2026; total investment rises to Rs 135 crore.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition 26 Oct - Shoppers Stop invests Rs 10 crore in GSSBBL preference shares, raising total investment to Rs 135 crore.

Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 21 Oct - Shoppers Stop released Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript detailing revenue growth, margin improvement, and store expansion plans.
